title: Polish Potato Bake
description: A hearty, crumbly potato bake with a twist of polish flavors. This dish is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Grate the potatoes using a box grater or food processor.
In a large skillet, sauté the grated potatoes with butter, salt, and pepper until lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour, caraway seeds, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Add the dry mixture to the skillet with the potatoes and stir to combine.
Gradually pour in milk while stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Transfer the potato mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
